notes.title: SNIPER ELITE V2 REMASTERED Launches May 14th - Upgrade Discount Confirmed
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34794722/b938a9df5da091198e4c7013030e0d0ae77678e3.jpg[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nKB1ioeA988

[h1]Independent developer and publisher Rebellion today announced an official release date for Sniper Elite V2 Remastered on Steam.[/h1]

The hotly anticipated remaster of the studio’s 2012 classic will launch on digital storefronts May 14th. Fans can pre-order [b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] from today and take advantage of a special [b]10% discount[/b] on the digital edition ahead of launch.

[h1][u]Discount for owners confirmed![/u][/h1]
We are delighted to reveal that Steam users who already own the original edition of Sniper Elite V2 can upgrade to [b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] for just [b]£6.99/$9.99/€9.99[/b].

[b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] features beautifully updated environments, characters, weapons and vehicles, modernized rendering and post-processing effects, enhanced texturing and level geometry, a revamped lighting system, and dozens upon dozens of improvements and refinements. 

In addition to visual upgrades, [b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] introduces a brand new frame-by-frame photo mode, seven new playable characters from Rebellion’s Zombie Army series, expanded multiplayer for up to 16 players online, and all the additional content ever released for the game, [b]FREE[/b]. 

[b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] is available to pre-order from today for [b]£29.99/$34.99/€34.99,[/b] with a special [b]10% discount[/b] until launch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/728740/Sniper_Elite_V2_Remastered/

notes.title: PYRAMID SCREAMS AFOOT IN THE THRILLING CONCLUSION TO STRANGE BRIGADE: THE THRICE DAMNED - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/9de611a6c59433af7b272d663bc42fc2b2565bbc.jpg[/img]

A perilous pyramid full of terrifying traps? A troublesome teleportation to the afterlife? This sounds like a job for... the STRANGE BRIGADE!

The thrilling conclusion to the Brigade's downloadable developments is here! 
Campaign mission [b]THRICE DAMNED III: GREAT PYRAMID OF BES[/b] is available now via the Season Pass or to buy separately. And, as revealed in today's new trailer, an old foe is back to terrorize once more - or should we say, thrice more!

Luckily the Brigade have another new hero in their employ. [b]Introducing tracker extraordinaire Anjali Khan[/b]! Secretly a ruler of a prosperous Indian state, Anjali has vowed revenge against the curse that took her family. To help her do just that, she's brought the Brigade some devilishly destructive new gear...

Yes, the [b]MAHARANI HUNTRESS CHARACTER EXPANSION PACK[/b] is also out now! Not only does it feature Anjali Khan as a new playable hero, it also bundles in her amulet power [b]Spear of the Ice Age, the special item Cluster Grenade, and the Audley A40 Exemplar SMG and Eastleigh M1 rifle[/b]. Like the THRICE DAMNED III, it's available right now via the Season Pass or to buy separately. 

What about the latest round of fantastic freebies courtesy of those Rebellion rascals? [b]Two new modes, two new Score Attack levels and a new Horde map![/b]

Shutter-happy snappers can delight in[b] PHOTO MODE[/b], while challenge-craving champions can test their skill with the new difficulty level [b]EXTREME MODE[/b]. Both are [b]FREE[/b] and available right now, as are the Score Attack levels "Great Pyramid II" and "Afterlife II" and the new Horde map "Void."

For more on Photo Mode and Extreme Mode, please visit StrangeBrigade.com

notes.title: Photo Mode, Extreme Mode as well as new Horde and Score Attack maps added FREE today!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/5c7e5312b6004c7eafbf6d2f01f4b664f10a7e81.jpg[/img]

Hey all,

[h1]Today's [b]FREE[/b] content includes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Extreme Mode
[*] Photo Mode
[*] New Score Attack map's. [b]Great Pyramid II and Afterlife II.[/b]
[*] New Horde Mode map. [b]Void[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Extreme difficulty added to the campaign![/h1]
This is a nefarious new difficulty level for the Strange Brigade story campaign, making every enemy more than a dash more durable, and every hit pack an even bigger wallop. Extreme Mode is designed to encourage players to put their thinking caps on and get tactical - use the environment wisely, pick your moments, and for goodness' sake try to stay alive, Strange Brigade! 

[h1]Photo mode![/h1]
Pause the play and amplify the action with a veritable variety of features. Use sliders to adjust focal distance, aperture and field of view. Place, aim and roll your camera to angle (ho ho!) for that perfect shot. Choose from dozens of filters including Noir, Matinee and Comic Book, and frame photos like a "Wish You Were Here" postcard, a classic movie poster and more.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/905361f7691e2cbc483033abd374b74263dc7479.jpg[/img]

notes.title: SAY CHEESE, STRANGE BRIGADE! INTRODUCING PHOTO MODE & EXTREME DIFFICULTY MODE
notes.content:
[h1]Those boisterous boffins at Rebellion are at it again. They've created two new modes for STRANGE BRIGADE, and what's more, they're FREE![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/5c7e5312b6004c7eafbf6d2f01f4b664f10a7e81.jpg[/img]

For all the savvy shutterbugs who yearn for that stunning shot of Ancient Egypt, [b]PHOTO MODE[/b] is coming! Pause the play and amplify the action with a veritable variety of features. Use sliders to adjust focal distance, aperture and field of view. Place, aim and roll your camera to angle (ho ho!) for that perfect shot. Choose from dozens of filters including Noir, Matinee and Comic Book, and frame photos like a "Wish You Were Here" postcard, a classic movie poster and more.

The fabulous freebies don't stop there! Also incoming - [b]EXTREME MODE![/b] This is a nefarious new difficulty level for the Strange Brigade story campaign, making every enemy more than a dash more durable, and every hit pack an even bigger wallop. Extreme Mode is designed to encourage players to put their thinking caps on and get tactical - use the environment wisely, pick your moments, and for goodness' sake try to stay alive, Strange Brigade! 

Both Photo Mode and Extreme Mode will arrive on Monday 26th November as part of a free update which also adds new Score Attack levels "Great Pyramid II" and "Afterlife II" and the new Horde map "Void." 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/9de611a6c59433af7b272d663bc42fc2b2565bbc.jpg[/img]

Fans can also look forward to the thrilling conclusion to [b]The Thrice Damned, which is set to arrive the very next day!  Campaign mission THRICE DAMNED III: GREAT PYRAMID OF BES and the MAHARANI HUNTRESS CHARACTER EXPANSION PACK[/b], featuring the new playable hero Anjali Khan, will both release on Tuesday 27th November.

notes.title: Strange Brigade review - brash team shooter that's just a little too dumb
notes.content:
A strange one indeed, this. Rebellion's efforts tend to be admirably direct in their titling - Zombie Army, Sniper Elite, Rogue Warrior, all games that serve up exactly what it says on the tin - and so it is with Strange Brigade, an all-new IP that is more than a little odd. What if the Zombie Army formula was transposed from the fuzzy VHS of a straight-to-video schlocky spin on World War 2 to the high-spirited world of 30s serials? What if Indiana Jones, but with a Path voiceover and a heavy dose of colonial derring do washing over that sense of innocent adventure? Best not linger on that last point too long - it seems that not many at Rebellion have, anyway.

Still, if this studio has forged a reputation for anything over the past few years, it's for making big, dumb and - more often than not - enjoyable action games. Strange Brigade takes the straight-to-the-point gunplay of Zombie Army and throws in its own kinks, doubling down on the co-op - the campaign can be soloed, or opened up to friends or strangers to play alongside you - and sprinkling the lightest amount of strategy atop the shooting.

And so you have four characters (five if you include the pre-order bonus, of course), all loosely drawn from some dusty archetypes, and all with their own particular traits. There's Frank, the thick-skinned and hard-edged veteran! De Quincey, the magician who can absorb souls readily and is a dab hand at sourcing secrets! Gracie, a Rosie the Riveter repro who's good with her fists and will remind you at every given opportunity - and a few more besides - that she's a no-nonsense Lancashire lass. And then there's Nalangu, the spirit warrior who can draw upon the supernatural as she draws health from the recently deceased.

Read more…

notes.title: Brand new modes announced!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/732ccaf65adc9fc846cd08e433e6645dc072c973.png[/img]

With just three weeks until the launch of Strange Brigade, we’re excited to lift the sarcophagus lid on two very exciting surprises: [b]Score Attack and Horde Mode![/b]

These two modes – playable in single-player or two-four player – will be available [b]FREE[/b] at launch, and we’re delighted to confirm that both will receive free content updates post-launch!

So what are these modes? Read on adventurer, and find out…

[h1]SCORE ATTACK – WHERE SPEED MEETS PANACHE…[/h1]
Score Attack is a fast-paced mode, all about cutting through large numbers of enemies with as much speed and style as you can, in an attempt to keep that combo-multiplier as high as possible! As you might expect, this ticks up as you take down your enemies in quick succession, but will deplete should you take too long to score a kill!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/81d7a01c6552ec701e6613add44053e6aac56bbe.jpg[/img]

As well as this, there are also big bonus points up for grabs – such as not taking any damage, racking up the headshots, and other devilish challenges to keep you coming back for more.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/cf1ab10dda9d07183d20e8e4f0118c00f8715a9d.jpg[/img]

We cannot wait for you try Score Attack – it’s a fast-paced challenge with plenty of opportunities to show off your skills!

[h1]HORDE MODE, WITH A ‘STRANGE’ TWIST![/h1]
Horde Mode may seem familiar at first, but the crack team at Rebellion worked their magic to take some of the core gameplay mechanics and reinterpret them in to a fresh new mode!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/36550a9f513d0afa6ae6834fd96c571b6ad11309.jpg[/img]

Similar to spending gold in the campaign to unlock new weapons, special weapons and more, in Horde Mode you accumulate gold by killing enemies – but how do you spend it? Do you splash the cash on the Flamethrower, knowing once it runs out of gas it’s done, or do you save your gold to open up new parts of the level to potentially unlock more goodies like health potions or loot? 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/544fe9f8168fb9ad097554f623277152ee915a28.jpg[/img]

This neat change helps to create a thrilling mode, whether you’re playing solo or with 2-4 players, full of tactical decisions to be made in the face of an unending horde of nefarious ne’er do wells…

[h1]IN THE NEXT EXCITING EPISODE OF THE STRANGE BRIGADE…[/h1]
There you go, keen adventurers. We’re thrilled to be able to show this off and we can’t wait for you to get playing! Check out the brand new screenshots to get your first taste of Score Attack and Horde mode!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/e8b82774a443888b208cfdd65337e2e6f84aff2d.jpg[/img]

Which mode are you most excited for? Come and join the conversation on [url=https://twitter.com/StrangeBrigade] Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/strangebrigade/] Facebook[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/rebellion] Discord[/url]

notes.title: Character Biographies!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/382e6da36c5beb7fddd24da240a9d4963c95bcf5.jpg[/img]
[h1]What ho, adventurer![/h1]

With the launch of [b]Strange Brigade[/b] on the horizon (well, [b]August 28th[/b] to be specific), we thought it high time you acquaint yourself a bit better with the four fearless adventurers that make up the brigade. From back story to loadout, read on to find out details about each character, as well as how they came to be a member of the [b]Strange Brigade… [/b]

[h1]Nalangu Rushida[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/c7c92e76efba2fdd64e47a84b5f4ccf82fdbf1d2.jpg[/img]

[h1][i]Years of harsh training hunting demons has bestowed Nalangu with rapid reflexes and a sixth sense for danger![/i][/h1]

[b]DEFAULT LOADOUT[/b][list][*][b]Primary:[/b] Chamberlain Automatic Rifle
[*][b]Secondary:[/b] Marley .45 Automatic
[*][b]Item:[/b] Molotov Cocktail[/list]
[b]DEFAULT AMULET POWER[/b]
Blazing Wrath of Ra: Harness the power of the sun god Ra. Leap in to the air then bring down a radial blast of fire!

[b]ATTRIBUTES & ABILITIES[/b][list][*][b]Fast Movement:[/b] Overall movement speed is increased.
[*][b]Vampire Strike:[/b] Nalangu receives a small amount of health from each successful melee hit.[/list]
[b]BACK STORY[/b]
[i]Raised from birth to protect her people from supernatural threats, it was only when she underwent the ritual trials to become a full Spirit-Warrior that Nalangu learned her destiny lay elsewhere. Following this new path led her to Lady Imelda Webster. Since joining the Brigade, she has travelled across Africa to hone her Spirit-Warrior skills and bested beasts and demons from across the globe.[/i]

[h1]Frank Fairburne[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/d7afb4e492ef56b2840f7bbea5bc49893684d617.jpg[/img]

[h1][i]A lifetime of service in the army has left Frank with a tough exterior … oh and a rather brutal headshot![/i][/h1]

[b]DEFAULT LOADOUT[/b][list]
[*][b]Primary[/b]: Westminster 1895
[*][b]Secondary[/b]: Marley .45 Automatic
[*][b]Item[/b]: Dynamite[/list]
[b]DEFAULT AMULET POWER[/b]
Chariot Charge: Charge in to your enemies with devastating force, knocking them flying and exploding on contact with the ground!

[b]ATTRIBUTES & ABILITIES[/b][/list]
[*][b]Tough Hide[/b]: Frank’s overall health is increased.
[*][b]Super Headshot[/b]: Headshots are explosive![/list]
[b]BACK STORY[/b]
[i]A veteran sharpshooter described as ‘the man with the coldest eyes in the Empire’ by his commanding officers, Frank’s seen a lot during his time on clandestine operations. However it was his assassination of a demonic cult leader in the Khyber Pass that brought him to the Brigade’s attention. Not that he knew it at the time! Motivated more by money than honour, Frank is a deadly addition to any expedition.[/i]

[h1]Gracie Braithwaite[/h1] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/b6a6819840ba1abac8711be56c5700047b66271d.jpg[/img]

[h1][i]The Lancashire Lass with a dab hand for explosive & fisticuffs. Remarkably useful in close quarter combat![/i][/h1]

[b]DEFAULT LOADOUT[/b][list]
[*][b]Primary[/b]: Leamington Model 14
[*][b]Secondary[/b]: Marley .45 Automatic
[*][b]Item[/b]: Grenade[/list]
[b]DEFAULT AMULET POWER[/b]
Curse of the Mummy’s Tomb: Wrap your foe in spectral bandages. Pull your enemy towards you then fire them forward as an explosive!

[b]ATTRIBUTES & ABILITIES[/b][/list]
[*][b]Fast Explosives[/b]: Grenades recharge quicker.
[*][b]Haymaker[/b]: Gracie’s melee attack has a large area of effect.[/list]
[b]BACK STORY[/b]
[i]Born and raised among the smoke-belching factories and dark satanic mills of northern England gave Gracie all the toughness and no-nonsense attitude she needed to survive. It was when she burned down a textile factory being used by demons to make human skin-suit disguises that she came to the attention of the Strange Brigade. Her blunt way of talking may not be to everyone’s taste, but there’s no denying her effectiveness as a Brigade operative.[/i]

[h1]Professor Archimedes De Quincey[/h1]

notes.title: Rip-roaring 1930s-style co-op shooter Strange Brigade launches in August
notes.content:
Developer Rebellion has announced that its rip-roaring 1930s-style co-operative shooter Strange Brigade will launch on PC, Xbox One, and PS4 on August 28th.

Rebellion, the studio behind Sniper Elite and Zombie Army Trilogy, unveiled Strange Brigade back at E3 last year, with an immediately appealing, and appropriately pulpy trailer. It sees teams of up to four players working together, in the guise of globe-trotting Strange Brigade agents, to explore dig sites, ancient pyramids, and mysterious caves - solving puzzles, thwarting traps, and battling mythical hordes along the way.

Eurogamer's Robert Purchese was quite taken with Strange Brigade when it put in an appearance at EGX last year, calling it "a breathless romp right out of the pages of a hammy British adventure mag". Its gripping blend of relentless, Left4Dead-esque action, and calmer, more cerebral puzzling - all wrapped up in that irresistible pulp aesthetic - might not be especially deep, he said, but there's ample scope for a "hearty dose of good old fashioned fun with friends for a few evenings".

Read more…

notes.title: Strange Brigade breaking out of sarcophagus in August
notes.content: Why didn t the Mummy go to the party? Because she had no body to oh no I ve fudged it. Forever getting my skellingtons and mummies mixed up, me. But here are four Egyptologists less likely to misclassify their cadavers. Strange Brigade was announced last summer – a pulpy 4-player shoot n loot set in a 1930s of unapologetic empire maintenance. You play a group of artefact stealers fighting against lots of dusty proto-zombos. Today, Rebellion (developers of Sniper Elite and the Nazi Zombie Army spin-offs) have announced a release date of August 28, and blown the tomb dust off a story trailer, which lurks below. (more…)

notes.title: Sniper Elite developer rescues troubled Oliver twins studio
notes.content:
Rebellion, the British studio behind Sniper Elite, Battlezone and Strange Brigade, has swooped in to save fellow UK outfit Radiant Worlds.

All 70 Radiant Worlds employees have been saved, including the studio's founders and industry veterans Philip and Andrew Oliver (them of Dizzy fame). The studio will now be renamed Rebellion Warwick.

Staff are being put to work on the development of other Rebellion projects, such as the upcoming Strange Brigade.

notes.title: Strange Brigade takes on mummies in demo footage
notes.content: Real talk: the only opinions I’m capable of having right now are related to ice creams that will see me through the UK’s unfamiliar hot weather. That’s why my emotions towards Rebellion’s next game, Strange Brigade [official site] are pretty much just “WHY ARE YOU NOT AN ICE CREAM?” Instead of being a delicious Twister, Strange Brigade is determined to be a third-person adventure thingy for 1-4 players set in a 1930s explorer kind of world. It’s all ancient evil and dirigibles and Egyptology and British Empire this and that. Aesthetically it reminds me of films like The Mummy – the one with Brendan Fraser, not the reboot with Tom Cruise which is confusing me every time I pass the local cinema – or the Tintin comics from around the 1930s. Maybe even a ’50s rendition of the ’30s? … [visit site to read more]
